description: A real 10,000-position supervised run, eight self-play games, and eight development evaluation games validate the pipeline. This is not the planned multi-seed final study.
limitations: One training seed and four development opening pairs cannot establish general RL improvement.
The source is a small historical game archive, not a representative sample of strong modern play.
Search budgets are shallow; draw-heavy self-play and truncated-game exclusion can bias learning.
These are development matches, not untouched final-test results. No Elo rating is claimed.
Pilot runs were executed before the initial Git commit and record that provenance explicitly.
